product.title: Western National Parks 7-Day Explorer (Camping)
product.description: Explore the American Southwest on a 7-day guided camping adventure from Las Vegas. Travel through Zion, Bryce Canyon, Monument Valley, Antelope Canyon, and the Grand Canyon with structured day-by-day touring, guided walks, and stargazing opportunities.
highlights: 7-day multi-park itinerary from Las Vegas through the U.S. Southwest.
Visit Zion, Bryce Canyon, Monument Valley, Antelope Canyon, and the Grand Canyon.
Camping-focused format with guided logistics and park interpretation.
Includes scenic drives, hikes, and structured daily route pacing.
inclusions: Some meals as listed in itinerary

start.description: Select Las Vegas pickup points available

itineraryItems.title: Day 1: Las Vegas to Zion National Park
itineraryItems.description: Depart Las Vegas, enter Zion National Park, and complete a guided orientation hike before evening camp setup.

itineraryItems.title: Day 2: Bryce Canyon National Park
itineraryItems.description: Travel to Bryce Canyon for rim viewpoints and time on the trail network before overnight camping.

itineraryItems.title: Day 3: Monument Valley
itineraryItems.description: Cross into Monument Valley with guided scenic stops and cultural interpretation.

itineraryItems.title: Day 4: Antelope Canyon and Horseshoe Bend
itineraryItems.description: Visit Antelope Canyon and the Horseshoe Bend overlook with scheduled photo and walking windows.

itineraryItems.title: Day 5: Grand Canyon National Park
itineraryItems.description: Spend a full day at Grand Canyon viewpoints and trails with guide-led planning.

itineraryItems.title: Day 6: Route 66 Corridor and Return Leg
itineraryItems.description: Travel west with Route 66 style stops and transition back toward Nevada.

itineraryItems.title: Day 7: Return to Las Vegas
itineraryItems.description: Complete final travel leg and return to Las Vegas drop-off points.

items.question: Is hotel pickup offered?
items.answer: Selected Las Vegas pickup points are available; confirm your pickup location after booking.

items.question: Is this a day tour?
items.answer: No, this is a 7-day multi-day tour with camping logistics and daily itinerary segments.

additionalInfo: Meeting and pickup details: Pickup can be arranged from multiple designated Las Vegas points depending on departure date and operational routing.
Provide your preferred pickup point at checkout and reconfirm with the operator before departure.
Bring weather-appropriate clothing for changing desert and mountain conditions.
